quote: The driver of a vehicle about to enter or cross a highway from a private way shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching on such highway.

activation.condition: An ordinary driver is about to enter or cross a public highway from a source-qualified private way.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Confirm original private ownership and access, public highway designation, feasible route and driver control.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: about to enter or cross a highway from a private way

judgment_calls_needed.note: Inventory every highway actor on both source-reviewed approach directions at each original frame.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: all vehicles approaching on such highway

judgment_calls_needed.note: Measure original vehicle trajectories, times and precedence; legal yielding has no invented numeric cutoff.

obligation.description: Yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching on that highway.

timing.description: Original approach and ego movement are measured through one 45-second episode.
